verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Your goodness and love and your mercy
Is always outrunning my sin
And when I fall short of your glory
Your kindness leads me to repent
Again and again and again

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Your amazing grace
Is on display
For all who would believe
And the evidence
Is found in this
That you would die for me

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Your grace it flows down for the sinner
I'm grateful cause that's who I am
If you could save me from my failure
I know you could save all of them
Remind me again and again

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
Amazing grace how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me
I once was lost but now I'm found
Was blind but now I see
